If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply no correction for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment swings from positive to negative within 5 days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% in the next 3–5 days.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 7 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 7 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon to avoid underestimation.
